pricing.plan: Realtime ASR, pay as you go
pricing.billing_basis: per second of session duration; transcribe-stream-2 has no published price yet, so this is the published Realtime ASR rate of transcribe-stream-1 ($0.36 per session hour); rate-dependent estimate, not an invoice

protocol_caveat: Early checkpoint, shared by Fish Audio for benchmarking on 2026-11-27; not yet in Fish's public docs or price list. Settings follow Fish's benchmark guidance for this model: manual turn detection with finalize sent right after the last speech frame, written text format, and diarization and audio-event tags off. The model is selected by the model upgrade header; session_started must echo transcribe-stream-2 and every requested setting before audio is sent. Fish exposes no build or version, so an in-place update cannot be detected. In manual mode a turn ends on finalize, on audio_done, or after 60 seconds (reason max_turn_duration), so the 15-minute private recordings and the few turns longer than 60 seconds are committed in 60-second pieces by Fish itself. finalize with no open turn gets no reply, so completion is audio_done answered by session_done; the reply to finalize is timed when there is one.
